title: quickstart: add guided “First request” + “Streaming” steps (copy aligned with Console checklist)
author: Wei Chen
description: Why: As part of the Console guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1: Hosted API self-serve), we want the quickstart README to mirror the in-product step wording and expected outcomes for the two earliest checklist steps: (1) “First request” and (2) “Try streaming”. This PR adds a short guided flow to the quickstart README that is consistent across languages, includes troubleshooting links for the common failure modes Support sees (401 wrong key / 429 quotas / streaming disconnects), and uses the same terminology as the Console checklist (project, test vs prod key, ‘successful request’ definition). What changed: 1) README: New “Guided steps” section near the top with two expandable steps: “First request (200 OK)” and “Streaming response”. Each step has: prerequisites, expected output, and a “If this fails…” mini-troubleshooting block. 2) README: Adds request-id logging note (so support/telemetry correlation is easier) and uses the canonical header names we standardize on. 3) Examples: Updates the existing first-call snippets to match the exact copy and ordering used in the Console checklist doc links (auth -> first response -> streaming). No API behavior changes. Notes: This intentionally avoids deep production-readiness content (covered by PR #604) and keeps the flow minimal so the first-time user can get to a successful response quickly. Follow-ups: after this lands, we should ensure the Console deep-links point to the anchors added here (ENG-23123).
commits: docs(readme): add guided steps section with anchors for first-request + streaming
docs(readme): align error copy with checklist (401/429/timeout/stream drop) + add troubleshooting links
examples: tweak request snippets for consistent headers + request-id logging
